integrity: All integer-parameter deductions supplied; finite enumerations independently corroborate but do not prove universal quantification. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The threshold is proved only for nonempty complete bipartite graphs, with unrestricted numbers of stars of each allowed length. Historical priority rests on accessible paper comparisons; unindexed work remains a risk. A later 2026 star-multipartite paper treats related multipartite questions.
title: A sharp degree-sum threshold for consecutive-star decompositions of complete bipartite graphs
